findings.title: Authentication present
findings.remediation: Add authenticated access (OIDC/SAML SSO — see src/deployment_kit/oidc.py, saml.py). No unauthenticated PHI endpoints.

findings.title: Audit logging
findings.hipaa: 164.312(b) Audit controls; 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D) Information system activity review
findings.remediation: Log who accessed what, when — tamper-evident, reviewed regularly; never log PHI payloads.

findings.title: Encryption in transit (TLS) configured or documented
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS everywhere, redirect HTTP->HTTPS, enable HSTS at the proxy.

findings.title: Encryption at rest addressed
findings.remediation: Document at-rest encryption (cloud KMS / encrypted volumes / encrypted DB) in SECURITY.md even if provided by the host.

findings.title: No hard-coded secrets in source
findings.hipaa: 164.312(a)(1) Unique user identification / access control; 164.308(a)(3) Workforce access
findings.remediation: Move secrets to env/secret manager, rotate any exposed secret, add .env to .gitignore.

findings.title: Dependencies pinned / lockfile present
findings.remediation: Pin exact versions (==) or commit a lockfile so builds are reproducible and auditable.

findings.title: SECURITY.md present
findings.hipaa: 164.316(a) Policies and procedures; 164.308(a)(6) Security incident procedures
findings.remediation: Add SECURITY.md: scope, honest limits, vulnerability reporting, incident contact.

findings.title: Backup / retention / contingency addressed
findings.remediation: Automate backups, define retention, and run a documented restore drill (see backup.py).

findings.title: No PHI-like identifiers written to logs
findings.remediation: Log identifiers/hashes, never names, SSNs, DOBs or MRNs.

findings.title: Role-based access control addressed
findings.hipaa: 164.312(a)(2)(i) Unique user identification; 164.308(a)(4) Information access management
findings.remediation: Define an RBAC matrix (see docs/RBAC.md), enforce least privilege.

findings.title: Risk analysis / incident response documented
findings.remediation: Document a risk analysis, threat model and incident-response playbook; run a tabletop exercise.
